title: NBA: Sixers comeback thwarts Magic, Heat stay hot
summary: The Philadelphia 76ers produced another double-digit comeback to defeat the Orlando Magic, 121-116, and extend their lead at the top of the NBA Eastern Conference on Wednesday.
